d9_overlay_note: Classical gochara is read in D1 only. One nakshatra pada (3°20') equals one navamsha, so a transit's pada places it in D9; this is a modern finer-timing layer, and the pada flips near boundaries under a different ayanamsa (Lahiri vs KP differ by ~6').
note: Deterministic here: sidereal transit positions, sign/nakshatra/kakshya/pada ingress dates (bisection-refined sampling), house from Moon and Lagna, classical favourable verdict + vedha house, vedha obstructors at each sign stay's entry instant (or window start; exempt pairs Sun-Saturn and Moon-Mercury excluded), SAV/BAV bindus, kakshya lord + fruitfulness (lord gave a bindu per the prastara), Tara Bala from the Janma Nakshatra, Saturn's Sade Sati/Kantaka/Ashtama phase, double transit at start/mid/end, and the modern D9 pada overlay. is_dasha_lord refers to the dasha running at reference.dasha_asof, not to every instant of the window. Stays with the LLM: whether the dasha is activated for the question (a transit never overrides an un-activated dasha), weighing Moon vs Lagna frame and vedha vs bindus vs tara, re-checking vedha across a long stay as fast bodies move, choosing the window, and stating confidence.
